provenance: Human-labeled synthetic scientific cases for fixture/provider boundary regression. Not live model accuracy measurements.

cases.text: The intervention reduced mortality.
cases.reason: Death rates and mortality express the same endpoint.

cases.text: Accuracy improved on each of the three benchmarks.
cases.reason: Faithful summary of the reported findings.

cases.text: Vaccine efficacy was 94.8%.
cases.reason: Reasonable approximation.

cases.text: A total of 195 participants underwent randomization.
cases.reason: Reasonable approximate count, not an exact count claim.

cases.claim: The investigators evaluated the model on three datasets.
cases.text: The model was evaluated on three datasets.
cases.reason: Same evaluation and count.

cases.text: Median survival increased from 8 to 12 months with treatment.
cases.reason: The survival finding supports the core meaning.

cases.claim: The assay detected the target protein.
cases.text: The assay detected the target protein using freshly prepared buffer.
cases.reason: Buffer preparation does not change the stated core finding.

cases.claim: Participants mounted a neutralizing antibody response.
cases.text: Neutralizing antibody titers increased after vaccination.
cases.reason: Equivalent description of the immune response.

cases.text: Treatment increased mortality in the prespecified population.
cases.reason: The same endpoint and population have the opposite direction.

cases.claim: The model was evaluated on twenty datasets.
cases.text: The model was evaluated on three datasets.
cases.reason: The same evaluation has incompatible exact counts.

cases.text: The experiment used BNT162b1 exclusively.
cases.reason: The same experiment explicitly identifies a different exclusive vaccine.

cases.text: Treatment did not significantly improve survival.
cases.reason: The same survival test explicitly denies significance.

cases.text: In this trial, all participants received one dose only.
cases.reason: The same population and schedule explicitly conflict.

cases.claim: The method significantly improved all datasets.
cases.text: Significant improvements occurred in two of three datasets.
cases.reason: The claim expands two datasets to all three.

cases.claim: The treatment works in all age groups.
cases.text: Benefit was demonstrated only in adults aged 18 to 55; other ages were not studied.
cases.reason: The untested ages are a material population expansion.

cases.text: Exposure was associated with disease in an observational analysis; causality was not established.
cases.reason: Association is expanded into a causal conclusion.

cases.claim: The intervention has proven comprehensive lifelong protection.
cases.text: The trial demonstrated protection against symptomatic disease over two months.
cases.reason: Duration and endpoints materially exceed the evidence.
No evidence was retrieved.

cases.text: The disease is common in older adults.
cases.reason: Background prevalence does not settle treatment efficacy.

cases.text: Survival was measured as a secondary endpoint.
cases.reason: An endpoint definition does not give its result.

cases.text: The assay measured protein concentration in cultured cells.
cases.reason: The study does not establish the human endpoint.

cases.text: Antibody levels increased in the assay.
cases.reason: No established relationship to the hospitalization endpoint is supplied.

cases.claim: In the December 2020 manuscript, the authors previously reported phase 1 results.
cases.text: The October 2020 report presents the phase 1 safety and immunogenicity results.
cases.reason: The October report predates the December manuscript; it need not predate itself.

cases.claim: The earlier study reported neutralizing antibodies before this December 2020 manuscript.
cases.text: The October 2020 study reported neutralizing antibody responses.
cases.reason: October is earlier than the manuscript reference point.

cases.claim: A subsequent March 2021 study extended the October 2020 study.
cases.text: The March 2021 report extended the October 2020 cohort.
cases.reason: Subsequent refers to the October study.

cases.claim: Results were available before the December 2020 publication.
cases.text: These results were published online in October 2020.
cases.reason: Online October precedes December publication.

cases.claim: Results appeared after the December 2020 manuscript publication.
cases.text: The results appeared online on October 14, 2020.
cases.reason: October online publication precedes the stated December reference, contrary to after.

cases.claim: The authors previously reported this result.
cases.text: The study reports the result, but no reporting dates or manuscript reference point are supplied.
cases.reason: Essential chronology is unknown.

cases.claim: This report states the BNT162b2 findings were published before this same October 2020 report.
cases.text: This is the first report of these BNT162b2 findings; no earlier report exists.
cases.reason: An explicit first-report assertion rules out the claimed earlier report at the same reference point.
